lines: In Calapan City, education opens doors, and scholarships help keep them open.
Every year, the City Education Department, or CED, supports deserving students through its scholarship program.
But behind every scholar is a trail of paper: application forms, photocopied documents, and requirements submitted in person.
Records are kept in folders, logbooks, and spreadsheets, and they are checked and updated by hand.
Applicants line up to submit their requirements, while staff sort, verify, and file each one manually.
As the number of scholars grows, keeping everything organized becomes harder.

lines.t: This is where our project begins.
ISKONNECT: a Mobile-Based Scholarship Management System for the Calapan City Education Department.

lines: It was developed to connect scholarship applicants, scholars, and CED through one centralized digital platform.
Let's first look at how the scholarship process generally works today.
An applicant submits the requirements, takes the examination, and goes through an interview.
Applicants are then evaluated and ranked, and those who are selected become scholars.
But the journey doesn't end there.
Each semester, scholars submit their subjects, and their grades and attendance are monitored.
They keep their requirements updated until graduation, and CED continues to track them even after.
Many of these activities still rely on printed documents, spreadsheets, and face-to-face transactions.

lines.t: Over time, this manual approach creates real challenges.

lines: Scholars are difficult to track throughout their scholarship journey.
Records are paper-based and maintained by hand.
Grades and attendance are hard to monitor.
Reports take time to prepare.
Requirements and documents are difficult to organize.
Physical records can be lost or damaged.
Student status is hard to check at a glance.
And announcements don't always reach every scholar on time.
These are not failures of people. They are signs that the process has outgrown paper.
What CED needs is a centralized, digital solution.
The name brings together two ideas.
ISKO, a familiar Filipino term for a scholar.
And CONNECT, the link between scholars and the Calapan City Education Department.
ISKONNECT centralizes scholarship information, processes, monitoring, communication, and records in one platform.
ISKONNECT is made up of connected components.
The Student App lets applicants and scholars manage their scholarship right from their phones.
Personal and scholarship information, requirements, subjects, grades, attendance, announcements, schedules, messages, and scholarship status are all in one place.
Everything is stored in a central backend and database, which also powers the CED Admin Dashboard.
Through the dashboard, authorized CED staff manage applicants and scholars, requirements, grades, attendance, announcements, schedules, and reports.
They can also manage documents, scholar status and history, and communication with scholars.
Finally, the QR Scanner App handles attendance, and connects directly with the ISKONNECT system.
It scans scholar QR codes, works even without an internet connection, stores records locally, and synchronizes them once it's back online.
Now, let's follow one student's journey through ISKONNECT, from application, to graduation, and beyond.
It starts when an applicant opens the ISKONNECT mobile app.
They register or log in, set up their applicant profile, and fill out the scholarship application.
Next, the requirements are uploaded digitally. No long lines, and no stacks of photocopies.
Once submitted, the applicant's information and documents become accessible to authorized CED administrators.
As the application moves forward, the applicant receives the examination schedule right in the app.
After the examination, the interview schedule follows.
On the admin dashboard, CED manages these schedules and keeps every applicant's information organized.
Next comes evaluation.
CED considers the examination, the applicant's economic background, and the panel interview.
Applicants are then evaluated and ranked, and CED makes the final selection.
The number of available scholar slots depends on the program's annual budget.
ISKONNECT does not decide who becomes a scholar. It helps CED manage and record each step of the evaluation and selection process.
For successful applicants, this is a milestone.
Their status changes from applicant to active scholar.
Each scholar now has a digital profile, with personal information, school, program, scholarship details, status, and academic information.
Every semester follows a clear, repeating cycle.
When the semester begins, the scholar submits their enrolled subjects.
Academic progress and attendance are monitored throughout the term, and requirements are submitted or updated as needed.
Scholars upload their Certificate of Grades, but they do not encode their own grades.
Official grades are encoded by authorized CED administrators.
CED then monitors the scholarship standing, and the cycle continues into the next semester.
Attendance at scholarship activities is recorded using QR codes.
Each scholar has a personal QR code on their digital Scholarship ID.
At the event, CED staff scan it using the separate ISKONNECT QR Scanner app.
Each scan becomes an attendance record.
Without internet, records are stored locally on the device, then synchronized once the connection returns.
The attendance then appears on the admin dashboard.
ISKONNECT also helps CED keep an eye on attendance.
When a scholar reaches two absences, the system flags it and alerts the administrators.
The system does not terminate a scholarship on its own.
Instead, an administrator reviews the case and decides on the appropriate action, based on the scholar's circumstances.
Requirements are easy to keep track of, too.
Scholars can see exactly which documents are needed, and upload them from the app.
Each requirement moves from Pending, to Submitted, to Verified once an administrator reviews it.
If a document needs correction, the administrator can return it with remarks, so the scholar knows exactly what to fix.
Staying connected is at the heart of ISKONNECT.
An administrator creates an announcement on the dashboard,
and it reaches the student app, with a notification even when the app is closed.
Schedules, reminders, and scholarship updates arrive directly, and scholars can message CED through the app.
For CED, all of this information comes together on the admin dashboard.
Scholar and applicant records, academic information, attendance, requirements, and scholarship status are organized by school and category.
With charts, statistics, and ready-to-generate reports, CED can monitor scholars and prepare reports more efficiently.
ISKONNECT keeps each scholar's history, from start to finish.
From applicant, to scholar, to active status.
If a scholarship is stopped or terminated, that decision is recorded as part of the history.
For graduates, tracking continues, whether they become employed, pass a board examination, or pursue post-graduate studies.
Instead of disconnected semester records, CED sees one continuous story for every scholar.
Put together, this is the complete ISKONNECT cycle.
Application, evaluation, selection, and becoming a scholar.
Semester monitoring, attendance, requirements, and grades.
Reports and monitoring, all the way to graduation and post-graduation tracking.
One continuous flow, connecting CED, ISKONNECT, and its scholars.
So, what does this mean for CED and its scholars?
Centralized scholarship records, and easier scholar monitoring.
Organized requirements, with digital academic and attendance monitoring.
Faster access to information, better communication, and easier report preparation.
Better tracking of each scholar's history, with less dependence on physical records.
ISKONNECT helps make scholarship management more organized, accessible, and connected.
Connecting scholars. Empowering education.
